prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning onboarding stages (redesign) and reordering steps (reorder) showed no clear effect, falling far short of optimistic predictions.
Adding new screens (new_screen), new guidance flows (new_flow), or path hints (hint) showed no clear effect.
Changing copy (copy) and adding desktop status indicators showed no clear effect.
Predictions for redesigns, step reordering, copy changes, and guidance additions were consistently too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +3.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.5% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -2.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.7% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -3.4% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Pet Animation Preview: Displays a playful animated pet preview graphic on the waiting screen while background pet generation takes place. (why: Adoption and generation take a median of 89 seconds and overall home step completion time is long (median 201s). Visual progress cues keep users engaged.)
1: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Instant Validation Checklist: Adds an explicit quality checklist below photo upload to guide users on lighting and pose before submitting. (why: Support logs 3 issues regarding custom pet generation failing or rendering improperly due to bad source photos.)
2: [finish, notification] Completion Desktop Notification Opt-In: Provides an opt-in toggle on the home intro screen to send a desktop notification once the pet is fully ready. (why: Mean finish time is high (5815s) indicating users walk away while waiting; desktop alerts help pull them back.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Split View Path Choice Screen Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen into a side-by-side split comparison card layout for ready-made vs custom paths. (why: Path selection drops off by 23.8% (76.2% conversion). A clear split comparison helps users make faster, confident decisions.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Account Pet Preservation Copy: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly highlight cloud account link protection against pet resets. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Adoption Pet Trait Showcase Screen: Inserts a new screen highlighting selected pet personality traits before finalizing adoption details. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9% conversion). Building emotional connection before final confirmation improves conversion.)
6: [finish, new_flow] First Launch Desktop Mascot Welcome Flow: Adds an inline mascot visual guide on the home intro screen showing how to summon and minimize the pet on the desktop. (why: Support had 3 emails about pets not showing on desktop and 3 emails about confusion on how to control or hide pets.)
7: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Completion Progress Bar: Adds a progress bar component and completion milestone badge to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and median duration of 89s.)

scores.note: Waiting screen info changes have proven strong results (+8.9%), though home step has lower drop-off.
High drop-off step with support evidence, but path hints historically show no clear effect or slight negative lift.
Addresses very high mean finish duration (5815s) by bringing users back via desktop alerts.
Redesigns consistently fall far short of optimistic predictions and show minimal impact.
Strong support mail evidence (8 emails) and low cost, but copy changes historically showed no lift.
Adding new screens introduces extra friction and historically shows negative lift (-2.6%).
Backed by 6 support emails on confusion; new flows had moderate past adoption lift (+5.9%).
Targets highest drop-off step (39.1% loss) using progress cues to encourage completion.
